pricing_rules: p50: Premium Tier (Section 14): premium is computed on the city of residence given in the Proposal Form. Tier 1: Delhi, Surat, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Greater Noida. Tier 2: Mumbai, Mumbai Suburban, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Vadodara. Tier 3: Nashik, Rest of NCR, Amritsar, Ahmednagar, Mathura, Aligarh. Tier 4: Kolkata, Rest of Gujarat, Telangana, Agra, Ludhiana, Beed, Jalgaon, Indore, Gwalior. Tier 5: Rest of Maharashtra, Rest of UP, Rest of MP, Rest of Rajasthan, Rest of Haryana, Howrah, Hooghly, North 24 Parganas, South 24 Parganas. Tier 6: Rest of India. There is no co-payment when an insured person from a lower tier takes treatment in a higher tier.

p53: Family Floater premium (Section 16): the eldest member of the family pays the full individual premium for his/her age. A flat 55% floater discount then applies to the individual premiums of every other member.
p54: Floater discount: flat 55% on the individual premiums of every additional member other than the eldest (continuation of Section 16).
p29: Online Discount: 5% on premium when the policy is bought online (company website, app or digital platforms). It continues on renewals while no agent or intermediary is involved.
p29: Employee Discount: 5% when an insured person is a full-time HDFC Group or Munich Re Group employee and buys through the website or app with no intermediary.
p29: Loyalty Discount: 2.5% on the policy premium when an insured person holds an active retail policy with the Company whose premium is above Rs. 2,000.
p29: Family Discount: 10% on premium when two or more family members are covered under the same policy on the individual policy option.
p29: The Employee, Online, Loyalty and Family discounts are cumulative, but together they may not exceed 20%.
p29: Long Term Policy Discount: 6% for a 2-year, 8% for a 3-year, 8% for a 4-year and 8% for a 5-year policy tenure, when the premium is paid in advance as a single premium.
p29: NRI Discount: 40% for an insured person who declares they live abroad for the whole Policy Year, subject to conditions.
p30: Discount in lieu of Commission: up to 20% of the policy premium in exchange for lower commission.

p30: Lifetime Discount: 5% on the base premium when all insured persons are buying retail health insurance for the first time. It applies only to fresh new business (not portability or migration) and only when all insured persons are aged 35 or below at inception. It then continues for life on renewals.

p30: Aggregate Deductible Discount for Optima Secure (column 'Optima Suraksha, Optima Secure, Optima Super Secure, Optima Select, Optima Lite & Optima Secure +'), when the deductible is opted for all insured persons. Discount by deductible amount, in the order Base SI <25L / Base SI = 25L / Base SI = 50L, 100L or 200L: 10,000: 7%/5%/5%; 25,000: 22.5%/15%/15%; 50,000: 40%/30%/30%; 1,00,000: 50%/40%/40%; 2,00,000: 55%/45%/45%; 3,00,000: 65%/55%/55%; 5,00,000: NA/62%/62%; 10,00,000: NA/80.45%/80.45%; 20,00,000: NA/NA/88%; 25,00,000: NA/NA/90%.

p51: Favourable Claims Experience Discount for new buyers with no claim history (all plans except Optima Secure Global Plus): 21% in policy year 1, 18% in year 2, then 10% in years 3, 4 and 5 (Global Plus: 5.25%/4.50%/2.50%/2.50%/2.50%).

p51: Favourable Claims Experience Discount when all insured persons have exactly 1 prior policy year (all plans except Global Plus). With a claim in the last policy year: 11% in year 1, then 6% in each later year. With no claim in the last policy year: 18% in year 1, then 10% in each later year.

p52: Favourable Claims Experience Discount when any insured person has 2 or more prior policy years (all plans except Global Plus): 0% with claims in both the last year and the year before it; 6% with a claim in either one of those years; 10% with no claim in either year. The rate applies to every policy year.
p53: An insured person aged 60 or above at the start of a policy year is not eligible for the Favourable Claims Experience Discount for that year.

p55: GST basis: the premium illustrations label the totals 'Total premium (Excl. GST)'. The illustrated individual premiums (Delhi Tier 1, SI 10 Lakh: age 15 = 13,836; age 38 = 21,758; age 40 = 22,281) match the Tier 1 Optima Secure rate chart. p1: The premium rates for the plans offered are annexed hereto with the prospectus (the annexure is not present in this text extraction).

p4: Lock the Clock: age is locked at entry; premium applicable to entry age is charged at each renewal until a claim is paid, after which premium is per current age and changes per age slabs at each renewal.
p5: Multi tenure policies: premium for the entire tenure charged as per the entry age; no additional premium mid-tenure in case of claims.

p5: Floater: if a member is added to the floater plan (or an individual plan is converted to floater), premiums are charged as per the entry age of the eldest member and locked at that age till a claim is paid; if the eldest member leaves, floater premium uses the original entry age of the eldest remaining member.
p20: Renewal premium will alter based on Age. For Floater plan, the age of eldest insured person will be considered for calculating the premium.
p20: Risk loading: never more than 100% for any particular health condition and never more than 150% for any individual; once applied, continues for all renewals.
p23: Zonal pricing: country divided into 2 zones (Zone 1: Delhi NCR, Mumbai incl. Navi Mumbai & Thane, Kolkata, Gujarat State; Zone 2: Rest of India); premium depends on residential city.
p34: Benefit illustration premiums are standard premium rates without any loading and exclusive of taxes applicable; considered for Platinum+ Variant and Zone 1.

pricing_rules: p2: Internal Tariff. Premiums are in INR, and the rates shown are for Zone A.
p3: Floater tables are keyed on 'Eldest Age/SI', so the floater premium is set by the age of the eldest member. Compositions run 1A+1C to 1A+4C and 2A to 2A+4C (A = Adult, C = Child).
p11: Note: base rates rise by 8% every year for all policies with RID from October 25, 2026 onwards.

p11: Voluntary Deductible discount grid by deductible and sum insured, for example: deductible 50,000 gives 5% at SI 1,50,000 down to 13% at SI 50,00,000, 11% at 75,00,000 and 8% at 1,00,00,000; deductible 1,00,000 gives 27% to 44%; deductible 2,00,000 gives 25% to 68%; deductible 3,00,000 gives 31% to 87%. The full grid is on page 11.
p12: Family Discount: 10% if 2 eligible family members are covered under one policy, 15% if more than 2. It does not apply to Health Guard Floater policies.
p12: Employee Discount: 20% off published premium rates for employees of Bajaj General and its group companies, only when booked in the direct office code.
p12: Online/Direct Business Discount: 5% for policies underwritten through the direct or online channel. It does not apply to employees who get the employee discount.
p12: Co-pay Discount, if opted voluntarily: 10% or 20% discount on the policy premium.
p12: Long Term Policy Discount: 4% for a 2-year policy, 8% for a 3-year policy. It does not apply if premium is paid in instalments.

p12: Wellness Discount on the renewal premium: 5% for 4 of 8 parameters, 7.5% for 6 of 8, 10% for 8 of 8. An extra 2.5% applies if all 8 are met and the insured walks 10000 steps on 20 days every month.
p12: Zone Discount: 20% discount on the premium for Zone B cover, 30% for Zone C.
p12: Room Rent capping discount (Gold and Platinum only): room rent capped at 1.5% of SI per day up to Rs. 7,500. For base SI of 3,00,000 and above the discount is Gold 5%, Platinum 8%.
p12: Overall maximum discount allowed is 55%.
p12: Instalment factors: 0.086 monthly, 0.257 quarterly, 0.509 semi-annual. Policies longer than 1 year can be paid annually.
p12: Optional Cover Waiver of Room Capping (UIN BAJHLAP21577V012021): 2% of base cover premium.
p2: GST basis is not stated anywhere in the document; whether premiums include or exclude GST is unknown.
